content: {"phoneNote":"The header already carries a Pokličite button and Navodila za pot link, yet the hero repeats both as bare underlined text links, so the first screen offers four weakly styled calls to action.","desktopNote":"Hero links are weak text underlines beside a strong header button, and the Vlečna služba section is a near-empty band with a lone word Gorenjska.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Remove the duplicated hero text links (Pokličite nas, Pot do nas) or make one of them the single styled primary button; the header already carries call and directions.","Give the Vlečna služba za Gorenjsko section real content or merge it into the services card; the stray word Gorenjska and the empty band look unfinished.","Fill the empty third slot in the desktop services grid with a photo for Vlečna služba and enlarge the service photos so the page feels less like a text template."],"blockers":["Both viewports, Vlečna služba section: an orphan word Gorenjska sits alone under the intro like leftover placeholder text, making the section look broken."]}
